question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.year) as num_seasons
FROM driver_standings ds
JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND r.year = d.year
JOIN constructors c ON d.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND ds.points > 0 AND ds.race_id IN (
    SELECT MAX(r2.race_id) FROM races r2 WHERE r2.year >= 2001 GROUP BY r2.year
) AND ds.points = (
    SELECT MIN(ds2.points)
    FROM driver_standings ds2
    JOIN races r2 ON ds2.race_id = r2.race_id
    WHERE r2.year = r.year AND ds2.points > 0 AND ds2.race_id = (SELECT MAX(r3.race_id) FROM races r3 WHERE r3.year = r.year)
)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY num_seasons DESC, c.name
LIMIT 5

    SELECT year, MIN(points) as min_pts
    FROM final_standings
